subject: POA: Lumenix trial — KPI definitions, owners & ops roadmap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Hollis <emma@lumenix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POA: Lumenix trial — KPI definitions, owners & ops roadmap

Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our call, here is a concise Plan of Action (POA) we think will help Lumenix validate Redwood for your content-enrichment pipeline. I outlined: success criteria (that will gate production), who owns each item, the evaluation plan, and a proposed timeline. Please review and confirm or flag changes.

High-level success criteria (gating for pilot -> production):
- Latency: end-to-end P95 <= 220ms, P99 <= 450ms for 512-token responses (95% of requests during business hours)
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s per model variant during peak synthetic replay; ability to burst to 120 req/s for 2 minutes
- Cost: average token cost < $0.018/token at projected volume (incl. batching/quantization adjustments)
- Quality: mean human rating >= 4.2/5 on representative prompt set (n=250), hallucination rate <= 1.5% on verification testset
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during test window; automated fallback to smaller model on capacity events

Evaluation plan (owner):
- Workload capture & sample set (Monica) — provide ~10k anonymized examples + label schema by 2027-05-07
- Baseline bench (Redwood infra team - Monica + Grace) — run latency/throughput baseline on representative workload by 2027-05-10
- Quality eval (Lumenix + Redwood SE) — double-blind human ratings + automated checks (Rouge/Exact-match) by 2027-05-17
- Cost projection & optimization pass (Monica) — recommend batching/quantization/caching profile, expected $/token by 2027-05-19

Ops & ownership:
- Test harness & synthetic replay: Redwood (Monica)
- Data/labels + acceptance prompt set: Lumenix (Emma)
- Day-to-day runbook & escalation: Redwood CS (Grace)

Immediate next steps:
1) Monica will share a test plan and sample manifest (attached) by EOD today.
2) Emma to confirm anonymized dataset delivery date and internal stakeholders for quality review.
3) Kickoff baseline run — target 2027-05-10.

Attachments: lumenix_poc_testplan_v1.pdf (test plan + runbook), sample_workload_manifest.csv (header-only sample).

Thanks — I want to keep this tight so we can get clear pass/fail signals quickly.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Emma Hollis <emma@lumenix.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POA: Lumenix trial — KPI definitions, owners & ops roadmap

Thanks Karthik — this looks good and captures our priorities. A few clarifications from Lumenix: 

1) Latency target: we care most about P95 under steady-state for interactive UX; P99 is helpful but we can accept up to 500ms if the fallback behavior is clearly documented.
2) Quality metrics: for the human rating we will use a 5-point scale and sample across three personas (editor, analyst, customer success). Can Redwood support segmentation in the rating UI?
3) Cost: our procurement team needs a conservative upper-bound for $/token for budgeting — can you include a worst-case + best-case in the cost projection?
4) Data delivery: we can get an anonymized dump by 2027-05-09. Procurement will follow up separately on the NDA and SOW.

Action items from Lumenix:
- Emma to provide anonymized dataset (2027-05-09) and list of internal reviewers for quality (by 2027-05-04).
- Procurement to send a preliminary SOW template to karthik@redwood.ai and procurement@redwood.ai (procurement@lumenix.com)

We agree with the owners but please add a short rollback/mitigation clause to the runbook in case the baseline shows degraded quality vs our current system.

—Emma
Director, Product Engineering | Lumenix

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Hollis <emma@lumenix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POA: Lumenix trial — KPI definitions, owners & ops roadmap

Emma — thanks, noted. Two quick notes and an attached test plan (lightweight) with the synthetic-replay commands and the suggested metric dashboard layout.

- Segmenting the quality rating UI: yes, we can tag ratings by persona and export CSVs for analysis. We'll include the persona dropdown and sample weighting in the test plan.
- Cost scenarios: I'll include three buckets in the cost projection: conservative (no batching, baseline floats), expected (our recommended batching + token caching), and optimized (quantized + cache hits). I'll provide token-cost estimates and assumptions in the attached sheet.

Proposed additions to the runbook (short):
- If quality drops > 8% vs baseline on core prompts, automatically route to fallback model and open an incident with CS.
- If P99 exceeds 650ms for > 5 min, switch to reduced concurrency profile (throttle) and engage infra on-call.

Timeline (updated):
- 2027-05-04: Lumenix to confirm reviewer list + procurement SOW contact (Emma)
- 2027-05-07: Redwood to ingest sample and validate anonymization (Monica)
- 2027-05-10: Baseline run and perf report (Redwood)
- 2027-05-14: Human quality review complete (Lumenix + Redwood)
- 2027-05-19: Cost optimization pass and final go/no-go recommendation (Redwood)

I'll attach: lumenix_poc_testplan_v1.pdf (contains commands/examples) and sample_workload_manifest.csv. Let me know if you want a short walkthrough video before the baseline run.

Thanks,
Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Hollis <emma@lumenix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POA: Lumenix trial — KPI definitions, owners & ops roadmap

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Emma: once you drop the anonymized dump tomorrow we will queue ingestion and confirm the exact replay window for the baseline run. Monica: please include a column in the sample manifest for "sensitivity_tag" so the Lumenix reviewers can mark any items that require extra redaction.

Procurement: looping you in to coordinate the SOW and the NDA. High-level ask from our side: a 30-day trial SOW with a two-week evaluation window and a statement that Lumenix will provide labeled quality reviewers for human evaluation. We can provide a standard template if useful.

I'll track owners and update the Jira (link above) with discrete tasks and owners. If there are no objections I'll schedule the baseline run for 2027-05-10 09:00 UTC and send a calendar invite.

Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
